samples.caption: A person wearing a helmet and white racing suit is riding a motorcycle on a city street.
A park scene with a paved path, surrounded by lush greenery and a few benches.
A black and white butterfly with blue spots is perched on a yellow flower with a blurred blue background.
A group of elephants, including a mother and her young ones, are grazing in a grassy field with a cloudy sky in the background.
The image shows a shadowy figure against a plain background, creating a silhouette effect.
A neatly made bed with white sheets and pillows, a bedside table with a lamp and a bowl, and a window with a view of a green field.
A white coffee cup filled with dark coffee sits on a white saucer with a silver spoon resting on the saucer. The cup and saucer are placed on a red tablecloth.
A white horse stands on a dirt road next to a wooden fence, while a car with a person inside drives past.
